name: manual_62390e
claim: Reservation locks held inside one instance do not share a spending ceiling: two CostGuard instances or processes can each pass their own check and together exceed the budget. Keep settled spend and live reservations in one durable store per budget file with an atomic check-and-reserve (SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE on a private file), let a reservation expire only after its own declared hold, and still record a late commit for a swept reservation.
